column2: No Crankshaft Position Sensor Signal While Engine Is Running
column3: Crank signal lost while running: check the crankshaft sensor connector and wiring, then the sensor.
Cam/VVT signal out of range: check the camshaft position sensor, its connector and wiring, and the oil level.
VVT-i fault. Check the oil level and condition first; then the VVT oil control valve (OCV) and its filter screen.
Backup power to the ECU memory was interrupted; often seen after the battery was disconnected. Clear it and see if it returns; if so, check the battery terminals.
Internal ECU fault (knock control processor). Clear it once; if it returns, have the ECU checked.
Electrical fault in the VVT oil control valve circuit: check the OCV connector and wiring, then the valve.
